Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 16

“But for those whose ignorance is destroyed by knowledge of the self, that knowledge, like the sun, illumines the Supreme.”

The sun does not create what it reveals. Krishna's image implies the Supreme was there the whole time, and knowledge changes only whether it can be seen.
